svg.title: Private equity and VC wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / ASSETS & DEBTS / PRIVATE EQUITY
20% called per year for five years. Distributions start in year six.
Each call lowers cash and raises invested capital. A distribution returns cash.
The fund counts in net worth and is excluded from liquid net worth.
Illiquid value is visible but never counted as spendable cash.
A fund stores its commitment, dated capital calls, and distributions.
A call raises invested capital and lowers cash; a distribution returns cash and records realized value.
The fund is included in net worth but marked illiquid and excluded from liquid net worth.
Calls beyond the commitment are rejected with a validation error, not silently trimmed.
